examples.text: El almacén era un frente para traficantes de drogas.
examples.en: The warehouse was a front for drug traffickers.

examples.text: La policía condujo una redada contra algunos traficantes de droga.
examples.en: The police conducted an offensive against some drug dealers.

examples.text: Tom no quería que ninguno de sus amigos supiera que él era traficante de drogas.
examples.en: Tom didn't want any of his friends to know that he was a drug dealer.
